Contract.title: Advisor guidance is packaged, imported once, and checked against current state
Contract.Problem: Intervention I-008 records P-015: advisor messages dominated reported cost, contradicted themselves and arrived against superseded ledger states; local root guidance existed in the framework repository but no packaged client resource or idempotent import. Client distribution must preserve project guidance.
Contract.Change: A reusable GRACE advisor guidance resource is packaged with the framework, with references that resolve in the installed layout. An explicit setup action installs or refreshes one OMP-discovered project watchdog import that loads that resource, preserves all existing project guidance, creates or rewrites no other project file, and is idempotent. `grace5-orchestrate` and `grace5-execute` tell the main agent to verify advice against current kernel and git state, resolve contradictions from evidence, ignore superseded observations without a repair narrative, and keep advisor context from the independent reviewer. A client without OMP gains no runtime dependency, and removal or relocation of the resource leaves no silently broken import.

Constraints.Constraint: No new kernel command, schema, receipt or approval; the setup action is a repository tool or template, not a kernel command.
An ordinary upgrade writes only kernel-managed paths; a project-owned root `WATCHDOG.md` is installed only by the explicit setup action, never silently by upgrade.
Watchdog files are project artifacts and source; the setup action's writes are explicit and reviewable, and no check result is fabricated.
One ledger entry records the packaged advisor-guidance resource and its removal criterion; no second scheduler or advisor policy is added.
Advisor advice grants no approval, observation or scope authority and never replaces the independent final review.
The pilot's `advisor.syncBacklog` setting remains a measured configuration change, not part of the packaged resource.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No event-triggered advisor scheduling, model substitution or advisor disabling; those remain separate experiments.
No global OMP configuration rewrite and no automatic upgrade installation of a project-owned watchdog.
No new advisor roster, second advisor or kernel mechanism.
No claim of token savings or a precision improvement from the guidance alone.
No client-specific paths in the packaged resource.

Acceptance.Criterion: A fresh client install loads the packaged guidance; an existing project `WATCHDOG.md` keeps its exact content plus at most one intended import; repeated setup is idempotent.
Custom project priorities remain effective, references resolve in each supported installation layout, and removing or relocating the resource leaves no unnoticed broken import.
A non-OMP client remains usable with no new runtime dependency; the packaged resource is present in the generated distribution.
The guidance tells the main agent to recheck delayed advice, act on current material errors and perform no stale repair; advisor context is not forwarded to the independent reviewer.
The documented setup surface names the action without adding a kernel command, and the generated packages and CLI reference stay current.
The packaged-guidance setup tool and edited sources type-check with the rest of the kernel.

Manual.Procedure: Replay three advisor findings against the guidance: a missing-trailer concern, an obsolete ledger warning and contradictory skill-boundary advice. Confirm the main agent checks the current kernel and git state, acts on a current material error, ignores a superseded observation without a repair narrative, and that the independent reviewer receives none of the advisor's context. On a client without OMP, confirm the repository remains usable and no runtime advisor dependency is introduced.

Decisions.Decision: The packaged guidance resource is the maintained source; a project watchdog imports it instead of copying a second body.
The project watchdog import is explicit and project-owned; an ordinary upgrade never creates or rewrites it.
Existing project guidance is preserved and at most one intended import is added; repeated setup is idempotent.
The main agent rechecks delayed advice against current state, resolves contradictions from evidence and omits stale repair narration.
Advisor context is not forwarded to the independent final reviewer, and advice never substitutes for that review.
`advisor.syncBacklog` and model or roster changes remain separate measured variables, not hidden in the resource.
A client without OMP receives no new runtime dependency and no fabricated advisor behaviour.
